items.t: Second gear can overheat and break
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN. If the transmission is already damaged, replacement costs much more.

items.t: Blinking D light from pressure switch or shift faults
items.note: If a shift solenoid or the transmission itself is at fault, expect more.

items.t: Timing belt may rub a bolt and fail
items.job: Inspect timing belt and fix bolt (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the belt broke and damaged the engine.

items.t: Passenger air bag inflator can rupture (do not drive)
items.note: Free under the Takata air bag recall. Check your VIN and ask the dealer about towing.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Headlight wiring can overheat and dim the low beams
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Stability control may brake on its own
items.job: Update or replace stability control unit (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Steering column may be assembled wrong
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank may leak
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Cylinder shutoff vibration, oil use and misfires
items.note: Many owners start with new spark plugs or engine mounts, which cost far less. Ask a dealer about goodwill help.

items.t: Lower control arm bushings wear out early
items.job: Replace front lower control arm with new bushings
items.note: Price is per side. Ask a dealer whether Honda's extended coverage still applies to your VIN.

items.t: Driver air bag may be missing rivets
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear damper bolts or spindle nuts may be loose
items.job: Inspect and tighten rear suspension bolts (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank vent valve may leak
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Pistons may wear and fail
items.job: Inspect engine; repair or replace if needed (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN. Outside the recall, engine repair costs a lot.

items.t: Fuel pump failure
items.note: Free under Honda fuel pump recalls. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel injector misfires
items.note: Ask the dealer whether bulletin 18-025 coverage applies. A single injector costs less.

items.t: Shudder between 20 and 60 mph
items.job: Update transmission software and change fluid
items.note: If the torque converter must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Connecting rod bearing can wear and seize
items.job: Inspect engine; repair or replace if needed (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN. Outside the recall, engine repair costs a lot.

items.t: Engine may not restart after Auto Idle Stop
items.job: Update engine software per Honda bulletin
items.note: Ask the dealer about bulletins 23-008 or 23-009. A weak 12-volt battery can also cause this.

items.t: Fuel tank welds may leak
items.note: Free under Honda recalls. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Hood may fly open while driving
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Timing belt teeth may separate
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the belt broke and damaged the engine.

items.t: Rear subframe can rust at the suspension mounts
items.job: Inspect rear subframe; replace if needed (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN. Outside the recall, a new subframe costs a lot.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor fault may fire the air bag
items.note: Free under Honda recalls. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image delayed or missing
items.job: Update display software or replace camera (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recalls. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake master cylinder may separate from booster
items.job: Inspect and secure brake master cylinder (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine computer software can cause stalls
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Loose steel ball in steering gear
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel filler neck tube may separate
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake pedal pivot pin may come loose
items.job: Inspect and secure brake pedal pivot (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driver seat cushion frame may be loose
items.job: Inspect and repair driver seat frame (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recalls. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Third-row seat belt may be trapped
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear subframe bolts may be loose
items.job: Inspect and tighten rear subframe bolts (recall)
items.note: Free under Honda recall. Check your VIN first.
